title: Sensory Contact
overview: Alexey Trantsev and Alexey Mutin lost their arms as a result of electrical injury. Years later, they have mastered bionic prostheses and currently handle the everyday tasks well. The only thing that is sorely lacking is the ability to feel with their hands - to feel warmth, cold, water, or to sense the beloved girl by touch. To address this need, scientists are developing a sensing system for prosthetic hands. Will they be able to create artificial sensations and what is behind the scientific discoveries?
